parsed.why: No local bathroom ban and on the low-risk list, but the national legislature's facilities restriction and executive override apply directly; protest arrests at the legislature; national passport and entry regime still governs visitors.

Standing criminal drag ban upheld, birth-sex facilities enforced via an indecent-exposure statute, prison and shelter exclusion, closed ID markers, panic defence, police indifference: hostile layers well below parent.

Most Protective tier: public-accommodations and hate-crime coverage for gender identity, panic defence abolished, X markers, 2023 shield law; only the national border/passport regime remains as exposure.

Worst of the five: bathroom-bounty law reaching airports and public buildings, private suits, ID invalidation with active notices, criminal and civil penalties; the legal-risk assessment labels it Do Not Travel.

Most Protective tier with a shield law, broad anti-discrimination, hate-crime coverage, X markers and panic defence abolished; comparable to dossier 3, above parent but capped by the national border regime.
